command:
source "$HOME/build-workers/worker-env.sh" || exit $?
pnpm fixtures || exit $?
unset IFCLITE_ADAPTER_BUILD
bash native/smlib-adapter/qualify.sh native
native_status=$?
source_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
checkout_key=$(printf '%s' "$(pwd -P)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)
export IFCLITE_SMLIB_WORKER="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/ifclite-smlib/native-$source_sha-$checkout_key/ifclite_smlib_worker"
runtime_status=125
product_status=125
if [ -x "$IFCLITE_SMLIB_WORKER" ]; then
  cargo test -p ifc-lite-geometry-runtime --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --nocapture
  runtime_status=$?
  cargo test -p ifc-lite-processing --lib element::session_retained -- --nocapture
  product_status=$?
fi
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
clippy_status=$?
printf 'native_boundary_exit=%s actual_runtime_exit=%s retained_product_exit=%s clippy_exit=%s\n' "$native_status" "$runtime_status" "$product_status" "$clippy_status"
if [ "$native_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$native_status"; fi
if [ "$runtime_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$runtime_status"; fi
if [ "$product_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$product_status"; fi
exit "$clippy_status"
scope: Full native CTest; all runtime targets; retained processing lib tests; strict workspace all-target Clippy. Not full workspace/browser/performance.
